name: GWENIFER RAYMOND
description: Gwenifer Raymond performs a concert at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto. The event is scheduled for December 13, 2026, starting at 8 PM.
longDescription:
Gwenifer Raymond is set to perform a concert at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto. The event takes place on December 13, 2026, with a start time of 8 PM.

The concert has an estimated duration of 60 minutes. Tickets are priced at €10, with a door price of €13. The event is open to individuals aged 16 and older.

Radioclube Agramonte is located at Rua João Martins Branco 180, 4150-430 Porto. The promoter for this event is Radioclube Agramonte.
